title: Product Support Engineer
description: Job Summary: Associate Functional Support Consultant responsible for providing support to HighRadius SaaS products and delivering continuous support from issue identification through resolution. Responsibilities include providing product support to users of HighRadius applications; owning customer-reported issues and driving them to resolution while meeting SLAs; providing a strong customer experience by partnering with internal and external stakeholders; and contributing to best practices for HighRadius Support services. Requirements: 2 to 5 years of experience in Application Support, preferably SaaS; familiarity with case management, knowledge base, defect and escalation management; a technology-centric background; strong logical, analytical and problem-solving skills; excellent communication; and ability to work in a fast-paced, changing startup environment. Additional job evidence also indicates SQL proficiency and scripting knowledge are relevant pluses and rotational-shift readiness may apply.
